# dicom_flutter_radiology_kit — Full API Specification & Reference Manual

## Module 1: Client (`lib/src/client/`)

### `DicomWebClient`
WADO-RS and QIDO-RS REST service interface for DICOMweb backends.

```dart
class DicomWebClient {
  final String baseUrl;
  final Map<String, String>? headers;

  DicomWebClient({required this.baseUrl, this.headers});

  /// Fetches instance metadata (JSON DICOM dataset) for a given study/series.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> fetchInstanceMetadata({
    required String studyInstanceUID,
    required String seriesInstanceUID,
  });

  /// Streams raw frames via WADO-RS RetrieveFrames.
  Stream<List<int>> streamFrameData({
    required String studyInstanceUID,
    required String seriesInstanceUID,
    required String sopInstanceUID,
    required int frameIndex,
  });
}
```

### `MultipartStreamReader`
Parses HTTP `multipart/related` responses into individual binary DICOM frame chunks.

```dart
class MultipartStreamReader {
  static Stream<Uint8List> parseMultipartStream(
    Stream<List<int>> byteStream,
    String boundary,
  );
}
```

---

## Module 2: Codecs (`lib/src/codecs/`)

### `FrameDecoder`
Interface contract for decoding encoded DICOM frame payloads.

```dart
abstract class FrameDecoder {
  Future<DecodeResult> decodeFrame(Uint8List encodedBytes, DecodeOptions options);
}

class DecodeResult {
  final TypedData pixelData; // Int16List or Uint16List
  final int width;
  final int height;
  final int bitsAllocated;
  final int bitsStored;
  final bool isSigned;

  DecodeResult({
    required this.pixelData,
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    required this.bitsAllocated,
    required this.bitsStored,
    required this.isSigned,
  });
}
```

### `WasmWorkerBridge`
Spawns `web/j2k_worker.js` Web Worker using `package:web` and manages transferrable zero-copy `ArrayBuffer` exchanges.

```dart
class WasmWorkerBridge implements FrameDecoder {
  Future<void> initialize();
  @override
  Future<DecodeResult> decodeFrame(Uint8List encodedBytes, DecodeOptions options);
  void dispose();
}
```

### `CodecRouter`
Routes DICOM Transfer Syntax UIDs to appropriate decoders (Uncompressed vs WASM Worker J2K/HTJ2K).

```dart
class CodecRouter {
  static Future<DecodeResult> decode({
    required String transferSyntaxUID,
    required Uint8List frameBytes,
    required DecodeOptions options,
  });
}
```

---

## Module 3: Imaging (`lib/src/imaging/`)

### `PixelFrame`
Preserves original 16-bit scalar pixel buffers without premature 8-bit quantization.

```dart
class PixelFrame {
  final TypedData rawPixels; // Int16List or Uint16List
  final int width;
  final int height;
  final double rescaleSlope;
  final double rescaleIntercept;
  final String photometricInterpretation;

  PixelFrame({
    required this.rawPixels,
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    this.rescaleSlope = 1.0,
    this.rescaleIntercept = 0.0,
    this.photometricInterpretation = 'MONOCHROME2',
  });
}
```

### `VoiLut`
Dynamic Window Center and Window Width (VOI LUT) pipeline.

```dart
class VoiLut {
  /// Transforms 16-bit scalar values to 32-bit RGBA byte array based on window center/width.
  static Uint8List applyVoiLut({
    required PixelFrame frame,
    required double windowCenter,
    required double windowWidth,
  });
}
```

### `WindowPresets`
Clinical DICOM window level presets (Hounsfield Units).

```dart
class WindowPreset {
  final String name;
  final double center;
  final double width;

  const WindowPreset(this.name, this.center, this.width);
}

class WindowPresets {
  static const softTissue = WindowPreset('Soft Tissue', 40, 400);
  static const bone = WindowPreset('Bone', 400, 1800);
  static const lung = WindowPreset('Lung', -600, 1500);
  static const brain = WindowPreset('Brain', 40, 80);
  static const abdomen = WindowPreset('Abdomen', 50, 350);
}
```

---

## Module 4: Widgets (`lib/src/widgets/`)

### `DicomViewport` & `ViewportController`
Interactive viewport for medical imaging.

```dart
class DicomViewport extends StatefulWidget {
  final ViewportController controller;
  final bool showOverlay;

  const DicomViewport({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    this.showOverlay = true,
  });
}
```
